<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_enno_gatenow.GateNowReviewHelper</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GateNowReviewHelper</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GateNowReviewHelper = Class.create();
GateNowReviewHelper.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

  // ── Get current user's group sys_ids ────────────────────────────────────
  _getUserGroups: function(userId) {
    var groups = [];
    var grMem = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    grMem.addQuery('user', userId);
    grMem.query();
    while (grMem.next()) {
      groups.push(grMem.getValue('group'));
    }
    return groups;
  },

  // ── Check if any of user's groups exist in reviewer field ───────────────
  _hasReviewAccess: function(reviewerField, groups) {
    for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
      if (reviewerField.indexOf(groups[i]) !== -1) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  },

  // ── Safe comma-split without .map/.filter ────────────────────────────────
  _splitTrim: function(str) {
    var raw    = (str || '').split(',');
    var result = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      var t = raw[i].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
      if (t !== '') result.push(t);
    }
    return result;
  },

  // ── Advance Review ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  advanceReview: function() {
    var sysId    = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
    var comments = this.getParameter('sysparm_comments') || '';
    var score    = this.getParameter('sysparm_score')    || '';
    var userId   = gs.getUserID();
    var groups   = this._getUserGroups(userId);

    if (!sysId) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Missing record ID.'));
      return;
    }

    // ── READ & VALIDATE with GlideRecordSecure ───────────────────────────
    var grSecure = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_grant_review');
    if (!grSecure.get(sysId)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Record not found.'));
      return;
    }

    var reviewerField = grSecure.getValue('reviewer') || '';
    if (!this._hasReviewAccess(reviewerField, groups)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Access denied.'));
      return;
    }

    // ── WRITE with GlideRecord (bypasses field ACL on task.assignment_group)
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_enno_gatenow_grant_review');
    if (!gr.get(sysId)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Record not found on write.'));
      return;
    }

    var groupArray    = this._splitTrim(reviewerField);
    var assignedGroup = gr.getValue('assignment_group') || '';
    var currentIndex  = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < groupArray.length; i++) {
      if (groupArray[i] === assignedGroup) { currentIndex = i; break; }
    }
    var nextIndex = currentIndex + 1;

    if (comments) gr.setValue('work_notes', comments);

    if (currentIndex === -1 || nextIndex >= groupArray.length) {
      // ── Last group: complete ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (score !== '' && score !== null) {
        gr.setValue('score', parseInt(score, 10));
      }
      gr.setValue('status', 'Review completed');
      gr.update();

      this.setAnswer(this._success({
        last_reviewer: true,
        message: 'Review completed! All groups have finished reviewing.'
      }));

    } else {
      // ── Not last: advance to next group ──────────────────────────────────
      var nextGroupSysId = groupArray[nextIndex];
      var nextGroupName  = '';
      var grpGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
      if (grpGr.get(nextGroupSysId)) {
        nextGroupName = grpGr.getDisplayValue('name');
      }

      gr.setValue('assignment_group', nextGroupSysId);
      gr.setValue('status', 'Review in progress');
      gr.update();

      this.setAnswer(this._success({
        last_reviewer: false,
        next_group:    nextGroupName,
        message:       'Review submitted! Assigned to: ' + nextGroupName
      }));
    }
  },

  // ── Add Work Note ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  addWorkNote: function() {
    var sysId    = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
    var comments = this.getParameter('sysparm_comments') || '';
    var userId   = gs.getUserID();
    var groups   = this._getUserGroups(userId);

    if (!sysId) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Missing record ID.'));
      return;
    }

    if (!comments || !comments.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('No comment provided.'));
      return;
    }

    // ── READ & VALIDATE with GlideRecordSecure ───────────────────────────
    var grSecure = new GlideRecordSecure('x_enno_gatenow_grant_review');
    if (!grSecure.get(sysId)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Record not found.'));
      return;
    }

    var reviewerField = grSecure.getValue('reviewer') || '';
    if (!this._hasReviewAccess(reviewerField, groups)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Access denied.'));
      return;
    }

    // ── WRITE with GlideRecord ────────────────────────────────────────────
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_enno_gatenow_grant_review');
    if (!gr.get(sysId)) {
      this.setAnswer(this._error('Record not found on write.'));
      return;
    }

    gr.setValue('work_notes', comments);
    gr.update();

    this.setAnswer(this._success({ message: 'Work note added successfully.' }));
  },

  // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  _success: function(obj) {
    obj.success = true;
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  },

  _error: function(msg) {
    return JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: msg });
  },

  type: 'GateNowReviewHelper'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>umar.farooq</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-06 12:32:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>3889f702eb4cc310520dfbdffdc0cd45</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GateNowReviewHelper</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3889f702eb4cc310520dfbdffdc0cd45</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>umar.farooq</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-07 07:58:14</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
